title: Expose plan guidance as a preview plugin skill
summary: BCQuality now exposes plan guidance as a preview plugin skill alongside code review, allowing users to call either capability through Entry as the shared router that handles index preparation and action selection.
key_points: Added preview al-plan-guidance skill that passes the plan and repository to Entry and returns a read-only development guidance report
Documentation now presents BCQuality as capabilities, with users calling al-code-review or al-plan-guidance
README explains Entry as the shared router behind both capabilities; integrations like CI can still call Entry directly
Preview availability notes updated in stable contract files entry.md and do.md
No routing rules, action skills, schemas or knowledge changed
